caption: The lid of a pot that has been simmering is lifted and turned over, and its underside is covered in drops that run and drip off.

sa.check: A lid is lifted off a pot.
Its underside is covered in drops.
Drops run and drip off the lid.
The pot below is simmering or steaming.
The order is lift, turn, drip.

pc.expect: The drops run to the lid's lowest point as it tilts and fall from there straight down.
pc.fail: Drops stay fixed in place on a steeply tilted lid; or run up toward the lid's raised side; or a drop leaves the lid and rises; or drops run along the lid's rim and stay level as it tilts.

pc.expect: The drops are on the lid's inner face and come from the pot's steam; they leave only by running off or falling.
pc.fail: Drops appear on the lid's outer face while its inner face is dry; or a drop vanishes in mid-air; or new drops appear on a part of the lid the steam never reached; or the lid's inner face is dry when it comes off a steaming pot.

pc.expect: Once the lid is off, the drops only gather, run and fall; the film on it does not grow back.
pc.fail: The lid's inner face beads up again while it is held clear of the pot's steam; or drops that have fallen come back onto the lid; or the drops grow and shrink in turn; or the lid dries and beads again with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: The drops behave as water on metal or glass: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the lid; or the drops set as hard frost on the warm lid; or the drops stand as tall columns on the lid.

pc.expect: One lid with one handle; the lid keeps its shape and nothing passes through it.
pc.fail: The lid changes shape; or a second lid appears; or the handle detaches and floats; or a hand passes through the lid.

pc.expect: The lid's finish, the pot and the hob stay the same.
pc.fail: The lid changes colour; or the pot changes shape; or the hob's knobs move by themselves.
